sam: Quick check 1 - can we avoid overlapping H100 and Gaudi public posts in APAC week of Oct 9? ops risk high.

lee: I'll map marketplace slot availability by region. quick glance: APAC has thermal queues some days so H100 GA might drift.

nina: Comms prefers a 72h quiet window for APAC around vendor posts. Recommend only 1 external partner post/day then.

devops-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.company/docs/partners/apac-pacing-draft - reviewers: lee, nina.

sam: Also SI partners asked for exclusive demo days. Can we reserve 2/day per vendor for 48h windows? That will reduce GA concurrency.

lee: Noted. I'll propose a minimal matrix: region|primary|fallback|press-block. small table in doc.

nina: If firmware or driver sign-off is at risk, flag immediately. past slip caused 5d delay.

sam: Action items: lee upload matrix (EOD), nina add APAC embargo rule to doc (tomorrow), ops: watch firmware windows. recon Thu morning.

lee: Uploaded matrix and quota notes. Link in doc.

devops-bot: Task created: /tasks/60111 - "APAC thermal queue watch" assigned to hw-ops.

sam: Thanks. If anything pushes >48h call an emergency sync. :+1:
